headline: Frontline Fury Escalates Across Seven Sectors
war_summary: Since the last dispatch the war‑map has sharpened. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre, its 24‑hour toll now 173,229 Colonial and 190,823 Warden dead with twenty‑one ownership changes; casualty streams and enlistments are still accelerating. Fishermans Row has surged to fifteen flips, Fort Ember the busiest post, and casualties climbing to 11,553 Colonial and 13,886 Warden. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to twelve flips, Colonial losses at 55,641 and Warden at 70,647, both casualty rates and sign‑ups climbing sharply. Farranac Coast continues to churn with ten flips, control split one Warden to nine Colonial bases, and casualties at 46,938 Colonial and 58,027 Warden. Linn Mercy logs eight flips around Rotdust and Lathair, totals 54,458 Colonial and 68,626 Warden casualties, recruitment rising. Gutter, quiet in the prior edition, has erupted with ten flips centred on The Parras. Stlican Shelf adds five flips, casualties 55,607 Colonial and 61,864 Warden. Meanwhile Deadlands, the northern Warden‑held sectors and several rear areas show no ownership changes in the last twelve hours.
